# Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition

<a id="stained-glass-whole"></a>
## #0 — Light entering a made aperture

Light enters a room through a window assembled from differently coloured panes. The panes give it determinate passages; the lead holds their boundaries; an image falls into the interior where someone can encounter it. Sun, aperture, glass, seams, room and viewer belong to this event. The visible colour carries the work of relations which the colour alone cannot display completely.

This is Frank Taylor's authored Mytheme of constructing from diaphaneity: composing a work so that its originating relation becomes perceptible through the differences of its materials. Its whole is the optical movement, from originating light through differentiated transmission to situated appearance and returning recognition. No particular historical window, cathedral programme or sacred iconography is being reconstructed. The source of the composition is the [stained-glass contribution and its explicit correction](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), where the window becomes a way of making the argument, with each source's distinct office active in the result.

The originating light has priority over the projected image. The viewer nevertheless encounters the image first and follows its differences back toward what made them possible. This asymmetry gives the whole its direction: what is prior in being can be later in recognition. **Bimba** names the Original order; **pratibimba** names its determinate reflected or refracted display. The room's image receives the latter office. Neither the viewer nor the maker supplies the Original by finishing the picture.

**Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for this authored whole and the corrected Original/display relation, explicitly carried by Q27's two contributions. The narrative development here articulates that existing operation.

<a id="stained-glass-spectrum"></a>
## #1 — The spectrum implicated in the light

The white light carries plenitude. Its apparent unity holds the possibility of differentiated colour, together with the relations through which the colours belong to one field. Within Taylor's optic, this full ordered spectrum figures **QL**. QL belongs immanently to the originating light as its harmonic articulation. The pane gives a difference a passage; it does not first create the capacity for difference in a contentless source.

The [native theorem spine](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** this relation in its own formal register. Its parent phases bear the complete positional field in inverse orientations. The First Spanda's source-to-expression and return-to-recognition movements are joined through their interference term; the achieved relation can turn back through what generated it. The optical whole makes this implicated fullness and differentiated return visible. It leaves the equations' derivation in the theorem field.

QL's sixfold body and eight-determination traversal therefore remain distinct from the number of panes in the window. The eightfold follows bare relationality, conscious circumstance, question/assertion, withdrawal/extension, determining capacity/instance, personed context, differential horizon and the return-switch. Its native `X/x` names determining capacity and local instance before any psychic reading. None of these relations requires a pane to receive a permanent number, tradition or colour. The window's local sixfold follows what the light, construction and encounter actually do.

**Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for QL as the ordered spectrum, under the corrected Q27 assignments. The spectral language is an authored formal/Mytheme articulation; it does not attribute modern spectral optics to a Śaiva author or claim that physical light proves QL.

<a id="stained-glass-panes-seams"></a>
## #2 — Colour acquires a passage; the joins stay visible

Each pane has a material, density, colour and angle. Its placement permits some transmission, bends or colours what passes, and leaves something obstructed. The maker joins these different capacities into an aperture. Colour gives disclosure a definite form; removing every difference in pursuit of neutrality would also remove the particular transformations through which the composition becomes articulate.

The original quilt distinguishes this construction from an opaque mosaic. A mosaic arranges fragments into a surface image; the window works through transmission and obstruction as well as arrangement. Its material joins participate in how light enters. This is why the window carries the method's construction from the beginning: choosing and joining its materials already determines how the source can become visible.

The lead cames carry the joins. They hold neighbouring panes in relation while marking where one passage ends and another begins. In the epistemic construction, those seams retain source provenance, historical discontinuity, translation limits, contradiction and changes of register. A passage through a mathematical derivation differs from a passage through a lived encounter or a historical text. Their conjunction becomes informative when a reader can follow where the warrant changes and what survives the crossing.

These panes, media, angles, densities, joins and declared relations figure **MEF**, the meta-epistemic operation of refraction. [C39 — Meta-Epistemic Framework](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** its office: a lens changes a question, a permissible inference or an act of judgment, while keeping its conditions inspectable. A source enters because its particular operation changes what the whole can disclose. Merely placing its name beside another name would leave that operation undone.

The correction matters at the material seam itself. The earlier quilt assigned QL and MEF jointly to the frame. Its later correction assigns the lead to the refractive apparatus and QL to the light's harmonic order. MEF makes distinctions available within that order; it does not stand outside QL as a superior authority which certifies the sources. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for these exact pane/seam relations, with Q27:2937–2950 governing the assignments.

<a id="stained-glass-projection"></a>
## #3 — The image appears inside the room

The coloured display is produced through the relation of light and made aperture. It appears in an interior and is encountered from a position. Looking only at the glass would recover its coloured matter and arrangement while missing the event of transmission. Looking only at the cast image would conceal the glass, its joins and its placement. The whole holds both the constructed opening and the appearance it makes possible.

This situated image is **pratibimba**. A source-reading, claim, model or essay section can receive the same office when it displays an originating relation under determinate conditions. Its particularity makes something available to another person. Its danger begins when that availability becomes a claim to possess the source, as if what falls here exhausted what can appear.

The viewer is implicated in the display's appearing. Body, position, attention and concern enter what is seen and what becomes significant. Taylor's [P5 — Gebser] **sources** the authorial demand for an invested reading of text and subtext. Seeing through includes being with what is seen and answerable to the situation's outcome. The window thus gives [A04 — Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) a whole image which **figures** contextual disclosure beyond an inventory of provenance labels.

A finished image can become a surrogate standard: other disclosures are admitted only where they fit it. The window keeps its conditions available so that this reversal can be recognised. The question can then pass from the beauty or persuasiveness of the present picture to the light, exclusions and construction through which it gained that force. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for situated projection and invested seeing, under the corrected quilt and P5; P5's Father/standard interpretation remains Taylor's, not a quotation from Gebser.

<a id="stained-glass-changing-context"></a>
## #4 — Changing light discloses the construction

As sun, pane, angle, room and viewer change, the projected colour changes. A later display makes visible a region previously obscured. Repositioning or changing a lens can reveal a difference another material could not transmit, or expose an aberration the first view concealed. The changing display gives the reader something to compare: which condition changed, which relation persisted, which difference belongs to the lens, and where the earlier account failed.

The order recognisable across these transformations belongs to Bimba/QL; the successive appearances remain pratibimbas. Recognition neither averages their differences away nor adds them into a final picture. A contradiction can mark different questions or a failed transition, as well as an error requiring correction. Its exact location matters. The coordinated display makes more of its originating relation legible because the transformations remain available to inspection.

The `180°→360°` movement names Taylor's contextual turn. The first-, second- and third-person positions cease to claim isolated completeness as their joint conditions become available. The viewer remains situated. The native account distinguishes changing a whole perspective from recognising the field which permits more than one perspective; context gives the positions and their transformations a co-present relation. Gebser's historical account of perspective and aperspectivity **historicises** that pressure through his [source house](../../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md), especially its paraphrase map at pp.1–3, 11–21 and 255–58. The geometry and its QL reckoning remain authorial.

<a id="stained-glass-atlas-complement"></a>
The atlas carries a complementary discipline. Its charts specify local domains and transitions on overlaps, including obstructions to composition. Stained glass gives this plurality its lived optical body: transmission, colouring, interruption, a made aperture and a changing interior display. [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** their placement within a differential field; [A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** their epistemic consequence. A chart-transition is not light passing through glass. Each whole retains the operation the other cannot perform.

Taylor's [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **sources** a further distinction within this complement: an atlas coordinates partial disclosures, while an attractor organises trajectories in a dynamical field. Moving among readings can change the interpreter and the future possibilities of interpretation. It does not turn the window's panes into mathematically defined attractor basins.

**Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for recognition through variation, the contextual turn and the atlas complement. These are explicit operations of the original and corrected quilt programmes, not new cross-story associations.

<a id="stained-glass-return"></a>
## #5→0 — Recognition returns to the aperture

The [shared Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold) **grounds** the source–articulation–recognition movement through its existing A04/A16 return. Taylor’s optical composition carries that structuration through light, differentiated passages and a changed viewer. Its cultural home is the authorial composition; its narrated room is unspecified geographically. Changing illumination and the viewer’s return are the image’s temporal movement, distinct from the dates of the quilt and its source witnesses.

The viewer returns to the window with a changed understanding of the image. What first appeared as a self-contained pattern now discloses the source, selected passages and boundaries of its appearing. The image remains determinate; recognition gives that determinacy a return. A seam can be examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment. The work of composition continues through what its own display has made perceptible.

The Original remains prior throughout this movement. Within a declared Context Frame, an achieved map can genuinely serve as Bimba—the local original or reference field—for situated readings which occupy the Pratibimba office. The same map remains pratibimba relative to its wider sources. [C38 — Bimba Map](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **defines** the contextual office. The [recursive Bimba carrier](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md#recursive-office) **grounds** this native relational office: comparison and correction can reach a situated reading, the relation between reference fields, or the local Bimba itself. An essay section can carry the whole relational movement from its own angle without repeating every other section's content. QL's native recursion supplies that capacity; the optical composition gives it a sensuous office. A technical harness preserves some conditions of a refraction—source, permission, transformation, consequence and review—so that the result can return through them. Its infrastructural office does not make it the Original or exhaust the world which sustains it.

<a id="stained-glass-source-boundaries"></a>
### The luminous image and its historical limits

[Dyczkowski's source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md) **qualifies** the optical reading through its source-matched transcript. Its p.65 lattice-window image gives a neighbouring account of light appearing diverse through limiting conditions. On pp.66–68, the mirror analogy expressly loses the external object which ordinary reflection requires: in the Śaiva account, the power generating the universe also hosts its appearing. On pp.69–70, an inert mirror or crystal can display without knowing; Vimarśa names the self-apprehending power inseparable from Prakāśa. The sun outside this authored window therefore supplies no warrant for a metaphysical source outside Consciousness, and the glass supplies no substitute for reflective awareness.

[A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** that metaphysical distinction in its own register. [Singh's Abhinavagupta source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md) **qualifies** the textual route: introduction, translation and commentary retain separate attribution, and notebook passages are not promoted here into edition-verified quotations. The window remains Taylor's composition, even where a traditional image gives it a precise neighbouring relation.

[Bohm's implicate/explicate source house](../../../../episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order.md) **compares** the process vocabulary of implicated wholeness and differentiated display. The relation is **Resonant with**, not an extraction of QL from Bohm; its unfilled passage ledger supplies no optical or physical proof. Gebser is used through page-specific **Paraphrase / Argued from** his historical method. Dyczkowski supplies **Paraphrased** doctrinal qualification from the local transcript. No new external quotation is claimed. **Interpretive standing:** the native optical assignments remain `human-amplified: yes`; no additional psychological, religious or scientific symbolism is assigned to particular colours or panes.

<a id="stained-glass-returns"></a>
### Returns from the whole

The complete construction **returns-to** [C09 — Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): the medium becomes readable through what it discloses. Its changing projection **returns-to** [C37 — World-Atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md), where the conditions of pictures qualify their claims to completion. Its apparatus **returns-to** [C39 — MEF](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md), carrying the source, angle, transformation, divergence and return of each determination.

In the essay's movement, the optic **returns-to** [M05 — Gebserian Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md) as the first constructed aperture; **returns-to** [M30 — Arche-Topos](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md) with the atlas/window distinction intact; and **returns-to** [M36 — MEF and Prompt Thrownness](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness.md) as an accountable refraction. These crossings carry a Mytheme into Argument, Concept and Movement. They make the relation encounterable without substituting the image for those registers' derivations, historical warrants or tests of actual operation.
